result.instructions: Tools for Cognito Forms, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which forms do we have, and how many entries did each receive this week?"; "Show me the latest entry on our job application form."; "Update the status field on entry 42 of the support form to Resolved.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cognito Forms data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cognitoforms_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cognitoforms_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cognitoforms_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cognitoforms_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cognitoforms_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the forms the API key can access, with each form's id and name. Good first call to find a form id. REST: GET /api/forms.

tools.name: cognitoforms_get_form_schema
tools.title: Get a form schema
tools.description: Get a form's schema: field names, types and choices. Use the field names when you create or update entries. REST: GET /api/forms/{formId}/schema.

input.description: Return the schema for incoming API requests (default false).

include_links.description: Include links in the schema (default false).

tools.name: cognitoforms_list_entries
tools.title: List entries in a view
tools.description: List the entries of one form view through the OData service. Set count to get the total, or ids_only to get entry ids only. The vendor OData reference does not list view ids, so pass the id of the view you want. OData: GET /api/odata/Forms({formId})/Views({viewId})/Entries.

view_id.description: The view id whose entries you want (see the form's views in Cognito Forms).

tools.name: cognitoforms_get_entry
tools.title: Get an entry
tools.description: Get one entry with its field values and metadata (links to documents and the admin view). REST: GET /api/forms/{formId}/entries/{entryId}.

tools.name: cognitoforms_get_entry_file
tools.title: Get an entry file
tools.description: Get an uploaded file from an entry: name, type, size and file link. The base64 body comes only when include_content is true. REST: GET /api/forms/{formId}/entries/{entryId}/files/{fileId}.

file_id.description: The file id from the entry's field value.

include_content.description: Return the base64 file body. Default false (metadata only); large files make big results.

tools.name: cognitoforms_get_entry_document
tools.title: Get a generated document
tools.description: Get a document generated from an entry by a document template: name, type, size and file link. The base64 body comes only when include_content is true. REST: GET /api/forms/{formId}/entries/{entryId}/documents/{templateId}.

include_content.description: Return the base64 file body. Default false (metadata only); large files make big results.

tools.name: cognitoforms_create_entry
tools.title: Create an entry
tools.description: Submit a new entry to a form with the given field values. The form's notifications, workflows and payments run as they do for a submission. REST: POST /api/forms/{formId}/entries.

fields.description: Field values keyed by the form's field names (see cognitoforms_get_form_schema). Do not set Entry.

tools.name: cognitoforms_update_entry
tools.title: Update an entry
tools.description: Update the given field values of an existing entry. Fields you leave out keep their values. REST: PATCH /api/forms/{formId}/entries/{entryId}.

fields.description: Field values keyed by the form's field names (see cognitoforms_get_form_schema). Do not set Entry.

tools.name: cognitoforms_delete_entry
tools.title: Delete an entry
tools.description: Permanently delete one entry, with its files and documents. Confirm the entry id first. REST: DELETE /api/forms/{formId}/entries/{entryId}.

tools.name: cognitoforms_set_public_link_availability
tools.title: Set public link availability
tools.description: Set when the form's public link accepts submissions, with an optional message shown while it is closed. Dates use ISO 8601 date-times. REST: POST /api/forms/{formId}/public-link-availability.

message.description: Message shown when the form is not available.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Cognito Forms
prompts.description: What you can do with Cognito Forms here, with example requests to try.
